title: Traditional Slovakian Pork Casserole
description: A hearty, French-inspired Slovakian pork casserole recipe that's perfect for a cold evening. Slow-cooked with tender pork and flavorful vegetables, this dish is sure to become a family favorite.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt and black pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add the pork shoulder to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Serve the pork and vegetables hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
